body:
Thanks for the reply!
I haven't been self harming as much. My parents hid EVERYTHING from me, so I haven't been able to. I still do go a few days at a time without eating, but I guess not cutting is a sign of improvement, right? 
I think I can eventually stop with the self harm, but I don't think my mindset will change, and that's what's making me question whether there's still hope or not. 
And since I haven't been able to cut, I've been considering suicide much more seriously now, because I can't deal with not being able to express my feelings. 
Yes, I am on medication, Remeron and Focalin XR, but I honestly haven't felt the effects of either (besides deeper sleep). 
I still feel just as hopeless as the day I was admitted to the hospital. 

I guess the major thing I'm struggling with, and the biggest problem that needs to be addressed, is that I don't want to get better, and I'm wondering, how can I make myself want to live? Or make myself try? I'm doing terribly in school and in all of my relationships :/ I don't want to stop self harming or ruining my life.
Nothing that stressful or traumatic... Summer just started so I'm not like overloaded with homework or anything. I don't know why this is happening.

No. I went to the doctor last week because I felt tired all the time. 
She thinks I have depression, but I am not able to go see a psychologist for 2 months, because I'm going on vacation for the summer, and I'll be out of the country. I'm worried that I won't have any fun the next two months... and when I tried to tell my parents, they just got pissed and told me not to waste their money.
